Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor application insights Java profiling, using Java Flight Recorder

Body.Content:
Application insights now supports Java Profiling using the JVM’s built in Java Flight Recorder (JFR) feature. This enables you to troubleshoot Java performance regressions. You can profile on-demand or automatically with configured CPU, and memory triggers. Java Flight Recorder recordings can be viewed and analyzed using your preferred tool, such as Java Mission Control (JMC).

Learn more about Microsoft’s investments in Java in a blog post on application insights profiling with Java Flight Recorder or by reviewing the Java Profiler Overview on our official documentation.
